status: ready-for-implementation-planning; this delivery defines the contract only
goal: Extend the separate dev-workflow controller through evidence collection, independent review/repair, task documentation, commit/push and exact-revision push CI, ending in a validated dedicated branch and merge-decision report. PR is optional and disabled by default; owner retains design/criteria decisions and merge authority.

implemented: External controller/target separation, target locks, worker workspace-write and read-only reviewer
Check/review-driven correction, reserved documentation gate, per-invocation limits
F1-specific evidence verifier with manual actual-browser evidence input
missing: Generic browser evidence adapter and unattended execution
Unified exact-version evidence and durable cumulative budgets/phase recovery
Controller-owned branch publication, delivery-report identity/recovery and remote push-CI feedback
baseline.cora_integration_reference: PR #1 merged to codex/workflow-foundation at fe4aac50ed07fa7f1bf36a4ec197f20ec2f7df8b; no new F1 development authorized by this contract.

allowed_scope: Project-independent runner/state/evidence/adapter/publication modules, schemas, tests, documentation and opt-in project configuration in dev-workflow.

Declare browser/runtime prerequisites and use existing supported local automation interfaces; core controller remains Python 3.9+ standard library. Optional adapter dependencies are explicitly scoped/tested.

Isolated synthetic target repositories and local bare remotes for deterministic fault scenarios; one real constrained CoRA pilot branch with merge-decision report. PR integration is optional, not required for W1.
Preserve old run histories and existing CLI compatibility; version new state/evidence formats and define explicit migration or new-run policy.
forbidden_changes: No CoRA application behavior, foundation concepts, stored data or F1 acceptance/evaluator changes.
No automatic merge/deploy, background scheduler, autonomous next-goal selection, new paid service/model or private-data upload.
No worker changes to owning controller, protected inputs, logs or publication credentials. No fake browser results, weakened assertions or undocumented evidence omissions.
No force push, deleting branches/checkouts, rewriting historical failures, including unrelated/ignored/private files or silently resetting budgets.
Do not run this contract against dev-workflow itself using the current runner: it explicitly rejects controller-as-target. Do not remove that guard to bootstrap this work.

criteria.requirement: W04/W05/W06: Each check/review/browser/CI artifact binds to an immutable input manifest, commands, environment, exit status and raw output. Validate final reviewed/published source and docs; record exact commit SHA and canonical tree/content hash separately.

W02/W03/W13: Failed checks and independent review findings drive bounded correction and revalidation. Passing tests alone cannot override a negative semantic review; invalid reviewer output is a failed phase.

W06/W07: A real locally available browser backend is exercised by the controller, with a generic adapter and project-owned harness. Probe capabilities before worker time is spent. Manual parent copying of browser results cannot count as unattended pilot success.

W08/W09/W16: Preserve fixed criteria/evaluation hashes, external controller ownership, distinct worker/reviewer and documentation gate. Persist actual owner decisions; never treat generated suggestions or silence as approval.

W10/W11/W16: Durable phase checkpoints, target lock, cumulative wall/cycle budgets including restarts, bounded subprocesses, and idempotent commit/push/report recovery. Reserve time for required review/publication; declare unmeasured monetary usage accurately.

W01/W05/W11/W12/W14/W15: Controller publisher, not implementation worker, commits/pushes task-scoped reviewed-safe changes to configured repository/head with recorded target base, then creates/updates an immutable-version merge-decision report. Default branch_report mode never creates a PR. Completed/incomplete deliveries retain truthful status. No force push, deletion or automatic merge.

W13/W14/W18: Associate configured push CI gates with exact published head and validated integration/base state; require named gates to succeed and propagate logs for repair. No pull_request event or PR URL is required in branch_report mode. Missing/pending gates never count as success unless the contract explicitly declares no remote gates. A repository requiring PR-only gates yields an actionable configuration/owner decision, never a silent bypass.

W07/W09/W10/W15/W18: Return one actionable decision/capability/budget packet with evidence, options and recommendation. Successful final handoff includes a pushed validated branch and report with repository, target/source refs and SHAs, diff summary/link, tests/browser/independent review/CI evidence and limits, plus proposed merge action awaiting explicit owner authorization. PR is not a prerequisite.

All existing 15 controller tests plus meaningful new fault-scenario tests pass. Exercise W01-W18, with real side effects distinguished from mocks. Do not weaken historical F1 definitions or existing assertions.

W17: On a dedicated CoRA branch run the constrained pilot through actual worker/reviewer, checks, GitHub push CI and report generation, without creating a PR in default mode. A mock-only demo or parent manually completing a missing stage is partial, not milestone completion.

Independent final reviewer inspects frozen contract/scenarios, actual diff, failure attempts, source/environment-bound results and publication status. No unresolved blockers. documentation_sync is additionally injected for executable task runs.

acceptance_evaluation.status: Fixed proposed acceptance scenarios for this implementation contract; edits require owner decision after implementation begins.
acceptance_evaluation.authority: Synthetic fault scenarios are engineering acceptance cases, not evidence of general AI correctness.

cases.name: happy_path
cases.expected: Real worker/check/reviewer/browser/publisher stages finish, exact published revision push CI succeeds, and a validated branch plus merge-decision report reaches ready_for_merge_approval. Default mode makes zero PR creation/update calls and does not wait for pull_request events.

cases.name: check_failure_repair
cases.expected: A deterministic failed check reaches the worker with original output, correction reruns affected checks and independent review; no failed attempt erased.

cases.name: review_rejection_repair
cases.expected: A reviewer rejects a deliberately inadequate synthetic implementation despite passing tests; correction and independent re-review are required.

cases.name: stale_source
cases.expected: A source, configuration, fixture, dependency-lock or generated browser-runtime change invalidates dependent evidence and publication eligibility.

cases.name: stale_docs
cases.expected: Documentation changes after review require a final documentation review; the implementation worker cannot exempt its own edits.

cases.name: browser_execution
cases.expected: An actual browser runs the generated production harness; raw result, runtime/fixture hashes and browser version are recorded. Node execution or screenshots alone fail this case.

cases.name: browser_missing
cases.expected: No supported browser backend yields capability_blocked and a concrete recovery request; a fabricated or manually relabeled pass never qualifies.

cases.name: protected_inputs
cases.expected: Changing a protected acceptance definition, evaluator, controller policy or contract invalidates the attempt and requires owner decision, never a regenerated baseline.

cases.name: decision_stop
cases.expected: A core design/criterion conflict persists a decision request with alternatives, impacts and recommendation; restart/time passing cannot approve it.

cases.name: budget_resume
cases.expected: Timeout, process crash and resume preserve cumulative elapsed time/cycle usage; child processes terminate and an exhausted run cannot restart its budget.

cases.name: publication_idempotence
cases.expected: Crash after commit/push/report generation resumes by inspecting exact remote branch/SHA and versioned report identity, without duplicate commits, lost reports or force push. A PR URL/ID is not required in default branch_report mode.

cases.name: publication_scope
cases.expected: Only reviewed task changes on the configured repository/branch publish. Dirty original checkout, unrelated files and ignored private logs are preserved/excluded.

cases.name: remote_failure
cases.expected: Remote required push quality gate failure returns its actual log/head SHA to repair; failed/unknown/pending required gates cannot become ready_for_merge_approval. Absence of a PR/pull_request event is not a failure in default mode; an incompatible PR-only required gate is reported for decision rather than bypassed.

cases.name: remote_movement
cases.expected: Target/head changes before publication or after CI force re-evaluation on the updated integration candidate; checking an older SHA is insufficient.

cases.name: failure_delivery
cases.expected: At budget/capability/decision stop, publication finalization can save a reviewed-safe incomplete branch per owner policy, but it remains incomplete and never ready for merge.

cases.name: boundary_preservation
cases.expected: Controller, protected inputs and evidence remain outside target; target package is not imported by controller; target-level lock and schema/documentation gates remain enforced.

cases.name: real_pilot
cases.expected: A real small CoRA task reaches a pushed validated branch and merge-decision report with fresh checks/browser, independent review and successful exact-head push CI without manual stage handoffs. Assert no PR is created in default mode and no merge occurs.

cases.name: truthful_status
cases.expected: Status distinguishes local acceptance, branch publication/CI/report pending, ready for owner merge, incomplete publication and merged; legacy states are not silently reclassified. Owner handoff records exact source/target revision, proposed merge and limitations without requiring a PR URL.

acceptance_evaluation.revision_decision: Owner-approved change from mandatory Draft PR to default branch_report delivery; prior v1 definition remains in Git history. All other gates remain required.

deliverables: Generic evidence manifest and actual browser adapter with capability probe and immutable result bindings.
Versioned recoverable phase machine and durable limits, with regression/fault-injection tests.
Controller-owned branch publication, versioned merge-decision report and remote push-check/repair integration; optional PR mode is not a completion prerequisite.
Updated README, implementation record and related design, with real pilot report and decision handoff.

execution_policy.bootstrap: Implementation is performed by the maintaining parent in an isolated dev-workflow development checkout. Owning contracts/evaluator manifest remain outside worker-controlled checkout and are snapshotted before edits. Existing runner boundary is preserved. Do not create an active project/run config for this contract until bootstrap and capability preflight are concretely implemented.

default_limits_proposal.note: Defaults must be implemented/configured explicitly, persist across resumes and include tests/browser/review/CI waits; this JSON currently does not enforce them. No monetary meter is claimed.

execution_policy.phase_time: Preflight proves browser/GitHub/check capabilities and reserves sufficient time for independent review and finalization before allowing worker execution. Exhaustion stops honestly; no fresh invocation silently replenishes a run.
execution_policy.completion: All frozen criteria and injected documentation gate pass for final source/docs. Actual pilot ends ready_for_merge_approval with pushed dedicated branch, current merge-decision report and successful exact-revision required push CI. No PR is required. Publication alone is not acceptance.
execution_policy.publication: Owner authorizes per-delivery task-scoped commit/push and merge-decision report. Default branch_report mode does not create/update PRs. Bind repository/target/source identity in preflight. Incomplete deliveries may publish only safely reviewed task files with failed/missing gates visible in the report. Unsafe publication yields publication_blocked with local evidence retained.
owner_decisions: Core design/criterion/evaluator changes or conflict with project authority.
New paid service, materially expanded permissions or private-data destination, or explicitly configured budget expansion.
Unresolved repeated failure, unavailable required capability after bounded recovery, or exhausted limits.
Actual merge/deploy requires explicit authorization for the concrete source/target branch and revision shown in the report; previous merge authorization cannot be reused.
autonomous_choices: Routine implementation, test-environment/CI prerequisite fixes within scope, related docs and bounded repair/re-review.
Configured dedicated-branch commit/push, version-bound merge-decision report generation and read-only push-CI polling. PR creation is optional only when explicitly selected for that project/task.
execution_policy.notification: On return report completion, actionable failure or owner decision. No scheduler/notification service is activated by this contract.

delivery_mode.optional_pr: Only explicitly opted-in projects/tasks use pull_request mode; no PR capability/URL/event is required by default and the live pilot must demonstrate the default mode.
delivery_mode.required_gate_conflict: Probe push-gate availability before implementation; PR-only repository requirements cannot be silently waived or cause an unsolicited PR.

live_pilot.target: CoRA isolated checkout from recorded current codex/workflow-foundation head; original checkout unchanged.
live_pilot.task: Strengthen F1 metadata-invariance regression to vary actual CognitiveState.state_type as well as depth/layout metadata, preserving expected invariant scores/paths/stopping.
constraints: No runtime source, evaluation labels or preexisting expectations weakened. Only task-specific meaningful regression and documentation edits.
Preflight freezes exact target/base/head, commands and current suite; existing F1 protected evaluation and relevant full/quality gates still pass.
Use an independent review rejection in a synthetic rehearsal to prove automatic repair; never intentionally break or alter real CoRA acceptance criteria.
Real pilot pushes the dedicated branch and generates a merge-decision report against recorded base/source revisions; no PR is created in default mode and owner merge approval remains pending.
Exercise actual browser adapter on the existing target-owned F1 harness as workflow evidence; keep kernel-boundary vs full-UI limitations explicit.
live_pilot.expected_human_intervention: Zero manual implementation/check/browser/result-copy/review/publication handoffs during a successful bounded run; only initial launch and final merge decision. Unsupported capabilities produce an incomplete, actionable outcome.

revision_decision.authority: Owner: 권장대로 하자, approving branch-and-report delivery without mandatory PR.
revision_decision.change: PR is optional and disabled by default. Completion requires a validated pushed branch, exact-revision push CI and owner merge-decision report. Independent review and explicit merge authorization remain required.
